# `transform_keys`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
transform_keys(expr, func)
```

Transforms elements in a map using the function.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `lambda_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT transform_keys(map_from_arrays(array(1, 2, 3), array(1, 2, 3)), (k, v) -> k + 1);
```

Result:

```text
{2:1,3:2,4:3}
```

```sql
SELECT transform_keys(map_from_arrays(array(1, 2, 3), array(1, 2, 3)), (k, v) -> k + v);
```

Result:

```text
{2:1,4:2,6:3}
```
